title: Asheron's Call Server Information
description: A document served at the root of an Asheron's Call server's public game endpoint. No fields are required; unknown fields are ignored by consumers.

schema.description: Canonical URL of the JSON Schema describing this document.

version.description: Version of the server information document format.

name.description: The server or world name as configured by the operator.

updated_at.description: When this document was generated, as an RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit offset, e.g. "2026-11-07T18:00:00Z".

count.description: Number of connected, in-world player characters, including bots and multiboxed characters.

updated_at.description: When the population was measured, as an RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit offset.
